editorial.blurb: Chop Suey King delivers excellent American-Chinese comfort food with fresh veggies, tender meat, and generous portions that keep locals coming back.
editorial.insiderTip: Order a lunch special like Mongolian Chicken for under $10—it comes with shrimp fried rice, egg roll, and a drink, and the portions are large enough for two meals.

topDishes.note: Crispy outside, tender inside, with bright citrus flavor
